description.value: Alchemist Distiller is an award-winning micro-distillery run by French couple Sandrine and Simon, who hand-craft distinctive spirits from Okanagan apples including gin, absinthe, vodka, and fruit liqueurs. Their Nectar apple liqueur won Canada's best fruit liqueur in 2023, and their range reflects a blend of French distilling tradition and local terroir. Cyclists can visit the Summerland tasting room for sales, tastings, and tours.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Alchemist Distiller is an active award-winning craft distillery with on-site sales and tastings. The website provides a full address of 101-18006 Bentley Rd, Summerland BC V0H 1Z3, which matches the OSM street address but conflicts with the OSM community field listing 'Naramata' — the website consistently says Summerland. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, or water refill anywhere in the website content.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'Naramata' but the website consistently gives the address as Summerland, BC V0H 1Z3 — the record should be reassigned to the Summerland community.
No phone number in OSM record; phone +1 250 317 6454 sourced from website only.

Tasting room has very limited opening schedule (website indicates Saturdays only, small groups of up to 10) — cyclists should be advised to plan accordingly, though hours are excluded from this listing per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate award-winning craft distillery with on-site tastings, tours, and bottle sales — a worthwhile destination stop for Okanagan cycling routes. Address discrepancy should be corrected before publishing.
enrichment_extras.notes: The 'Packed lunches' required criterion is marked false (not null) because the business exclusively sells distilled spirits and liqueurs — no food products of any kind are offered, making a positive value structurally impossible rather than merely unconfirmed.

Packed lunches.detail: Spirits and liqueurs only — no food products listed on the website
